visual: Large isometric / orthographic three-quarter aerial diorama of RED RIVER TOWN'S OLD LANDFILL MINE. Far background: derelict chemical industrial infrastructure, inactive storage tanks, broken pipe racks and weathered factory shells. Main emphasis is man-made landfill deposits rather than a natural mountain ore mine. Large terrain footprint, numerous environmental details, spacious readable composition, overcast dry dusty daylight. Use a cohesive world scene instead of separate object samples.

visual: Large isometric elevated URBAN VERTICAL SCENE in IDEAL CITY at first morning sunlight. A dense, functioning advanced city district of many closely packed high-rise towers at varied heights, clean silver-gray faceted buildings with restrained muted blue glazing. Foreground: an upper-floor lounge partly opened for the viewer, sofas and a small table with two simple glasses behind a dramatic FLOOR-TO-CEILING GLASS WINDOW; the view through that window opens directly onto the surrounding city, not an enclosed courtyard. Several sleek MAGLEV TRAINS are visibly threading between the skyscrapers at different mid-building elevations. A NEARBY DIFFERENT TOWER has a clear rooftop landing platform where a bulky fictional 'Electric Ray' TRANSPORT AIRCRAFT is just settling down, intact and static, with a few tiny blocky R15 soldiers carrying ONE small cargo case toward the rooftop access door. Show lounge window, dense skyline, between-building trains, and neighboring rooftop aircraft together in ONE coherent large isometric scene. Aircraft external form and rail-support layout are artistic interpretations; no real brand. This place is prosperous intact futuristic city architecture, not ruined scrapyard. Strong vertical scale, layered depth, warm sunrise highlights and cool shadow, all key features readable. No giant helicopter filling frame, no full city viewed too distantly to see the window room, no detached furniture panels.

name: 117号避难所
artNote: 地下建筑外壳与局部剖视；三层向下收窄、双闸门、半月大厅和功能分区有原文依据，具体外壳和设备摆位为美术补充。
visual: ONE coherent isometric architectural CUTAWAY ENVIRONMENT RENDER of VAULT 117 beneath Garden Street METRO, showing both its external underground concrete/steel shell and selected interiors. A broad cut earth/rock mass supports a small ruined street and a metro station/tunnel across the upper back; this metro access leads through TWO SEQUENTIAL RECTANGULAR PRESSURE DOORS with a short buffer chamber into the shelter. The shelter has EXACTLY THREE SUBTERRANEAN LEVELS, with floor footprints progressively SMALLER DOWNWARD, like a stepped INVERTED PYRAMID: largest upper level, medium middle level, smallest lowest level. Keep structure three connected stacked levels, not an exploded diagram. Upper B1: approximately five-meter-height semicircular entrance hall, resident plaza behind, TWO CURVED CORRIDORS defining the plaza and FOUR WEDGE-SHAPED SIDE SECTORS; show just partial readable room fittings such as a canteen, reading shelves, small clinic, compact basketball space rather than numerous indistinct rooms. Middle B2: water supply utility, a workshop and hydroponic growing trays; a small concealed emergency chamber contains compact rows of CLOSED OPAQUE sleep capsules, representing the documented twenty-capsule room without showing occupants. Small lowest B3: modest administrator office beside a SHUT-DOWN reactor with dark inactive core exterior. Sparse backup-powered practical lights; reactor is OFF, no brilliant active nuclear glow. Muted concrete gray, steel gray, subdued blue details, warm amber emergency lights, aged intact infrastructure. A few tiny R15 explorers in blue coats supply scale. No above-ground palace or giant freestanding vault building, no fourth basement, no widening lower levels, no glowing rows of inhabited clone tubes, no exposed human remains. This must feel like a finished in-game environment concept, not a technical plan; visible intact shell, exterior metro context and open interior occupy balanced parts of ONE wide image.

name: 温室遗址
artNote: 清理前的五层塔形温室外观与局部内部剖视；只展示少量地下区域，不将深层排水和反应堆猜测画作已探明结构。
visual: ONE cohesive three-quarter isometric architectural GAME EFFECT RENDER of the GREENHOUSE RUINS before clearance. Main structure is a tall robust TOWER-LIKE integrated greenhouse in an abandoned residential neighborhood northeast of the wetland park, NOT a small one-storey farm polytunnel. Show FIVE above-ground storeys with strong weathered structural ribs and inset glazed growing panels, an old rust-stuck electrically operated front door, and a small adjoining warehouse/service annex with the discovered emergency/fire access door and a dim status light. Preserve a substantial intact exterior facade and roof; remove only a near-side vertical portion of wall to reveal selected interiors as a coherent dollhouse cutaway. Interior: dense cultivation units with broad pointed olive-green SPIRIT LEAF plants, visible automated lighting/ventilation/supply ducts in still-functioning areas, pale silk webbing and a LONG ROW OF HANGING COCOONS near a service passage, several brown/tan DEVIL MOTHS of roughly forearm length resting or hovering. Component image references show the exact low-poly moth and leaf design ONLY; use them as SMALL environmental inhabitants/plantings in the large building, never as oversized foreground product icons. A narrow service stair and closable inter-floor passage connect levels. Show only a SMALL UPPER BASEMENT SLICE below the ground line, with deeper floors continuing out of view into solid earth: documentation describes ten basement levels, but this view does not need to expose them all, and the hypothesized deep reactor/drain/nest must NOT be asserted as established. Choose the pre-clearance moth/Spirit Leaf state, no post-clearance corn field mixed into the same scene. Tower weathered but structurally resistant, muted concrete/steel exterior, dusty green glazing, cooler abandoned neighborhood outside and warm enclosed cultivation light inside. No fire, battle, wounds, bodies or active weapons. One or two tiny fully clothed R15 explorers near the annex entrance give scale. Exterior and partial interior both clearly visible, no separate panels or technical floorplan.
